testCase.name: [local] S17 The phone keeps no patient data beyond the session cache: after a delete on the computer, and after a normal run and Sign out

descriptionHtml:
Decision D5 · P0 · Daniela

After a patient is deleted, a Quick Dictation box with their name, room and dictated text remains — delete it too?; and a deleted patient's unsent text stays in another device's draft store until sign-out (Q10)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-01/S20

Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S17 The phone keeps no patient data beyond the session cache: after a delete on the computer, and after a normal run and Sign out

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4a No patient data is cached on the device beyond the minimal session cache: after a normal TC-25 run and after Sign out, the phone's IndexedDB, localStorage, sessionStorage and Cache Storage hold no pa … (TFA-92570 AC 7; TFA-94704 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T4b A patient deleted on the other device leaves nothing behind on this one: no copy of its name, id or chart text in the device's storage. (TFA-92570 AC 7)
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time. (UAT TC-25 step 5; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 18; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given (a) Phone typed into {hospitalPatient}'s pre-round notes; within 500 ms (inside the 800 ms autosave) the computer deletes {hospitalPatient}. (b) A normal two-device run as S01 (add, pre-round save, Generate) with the phone context kept, then Settings -> Sign out on the phone

When Read the phone context's IndexedDB (every database, including 'roundcompanion-session-drafts'), localStorage, sessionStorage and Cache Storage read-only: (a) at +1 s, +60 s and after a reload, and check the computer's Hospital list and the server after the phone's +60 s read and after its reload; …

Then (a) No row or value holds the deleted chart's id, the patient's name or the typed text; the patient does not come back on the computer's list, and the server has no rounding row with that name or id and none holding 'QA-SYNC-PR-E' (no pending autosave or unmount flush re-created it). (b) After Sign out nothing holds a patient name, id or chart text; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Scripted, read-only. (a) zero IndexedDB rows whose id contains the deleted chart id; zero storage values containing the name or 'QA-SYNC-PR-E'; computer list mustNotContain {hospitalPatient}; adminQuery: zero rounding rows for the account with that name or id, and zero rows containing 'QA-SYNC-PR-E'. (b) after Sign out, zero values with any patient name, id or chart marker; …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows; to be decided by Daniela.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S17

The phone keeps no patient data beyond the session cache: after a delete on the computer, and after a normal run and Sign out

Tickets: TFA-92570 Mobile: Capacitor wrap for App Store & Google Play (ready for qa); TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-92570 (2026-10-14; not yet checked by Quinn): needs a person. A deleted patient's unsent text stays in the other device's draft store until sign-out (TFA-92570 AC 7, T4b); the matrix says to report it against Q10, now part of D5 (Daniela). T4a's source is TFA-92570 AC 7, which is ready for QA, so its gate goes. The run's own result was pass; its evidence is below.

New local lane probes: status passed-partial in probes/results.json → passed (partly passed (every judged cell passed; part was not run / was mocked)).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): sync-probe: (a) phone types, computer deletes 500 ms later; phone storage dumped at +1 s, +60 s, after reload (record-only, Q10); computer list and server rows (admin scan) must not bring the chart back; (b) both modes: computer adds, phone Save Note + Generate (LIVE), storage listed by store (Q10), Settings → Sign out, storage must hold no patient name/id/marker. [Review 2026-10-14] Labelled passed-partial ((b) Generate gated); patch carries partial.needs = ['generate']. — Read-only page.evaluate of IndexedDB / Web Storage / Cache Storage + admin reads.

Detail:

Partial — 3/3 judged cells pass ((a) server + computer; (b) Hospital, NH after Sign out), (b)'s Generate step NOT RUN. (a) computer deletes 500 ms after the phone typed: the patient never returns on the computer (at +60 s and after the phone's reload) and the server has no row with the name, id or 'QA-SYNC-PR-E'. Device storage (record-only, Q10): the phone's IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts' keeps a row with the deleted chart's id and the typed text at +1 s, +60 s and after reload (drafts are not removed on a patient delete). (b) both modes: after Settings → Sign out no store holds a patient name, id or chart marker; end of run the Hospital phone held patient text only in the session-draft store (Q10).

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — sync-probe (scripted, not written yet): two createAuthSession contexts (local admin key), read-only device-storage reads, an adminQuery of the account's rounding rows, and in (b) Settings -> Sign out on the phone, which dev refuses (it ends the saved sign-in); so as designed it runs on the local …. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
